Self-telemetry of the `otelcol-sidecar` Collector (`metrics-apm.app.otelcol_sidecar*`, `service.name: otelcol-sidecar`).

**Queue depth** (top-left) is the headline: a rising staircase that drains to zero means the link to the central backend was down and the durable on-disk queue buffered the agent's telemetry until recovery.

_Failures_ shows `otelcol_receiver_refused_*` (always present). `otelcol_exporter_send_failed_*` / `otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_*` are arrives-later fields — they only materialize on permanent send/enqueue failure (which the durable queue is designed to prevent), so they are absent until then.", "settings": {"open_links_in_new_tab": true}}, "panelIndex":
